department: Natural Resources and Environment (UPC Manresa, EMIT)

deadline.value: Applications are open all year; the applicant chooses the year to start.
deadline.quote: Open all year. Choose the year you wish to start in.

supervisor.value: A director's endorsement must be attached to the application.
supervisor.quote: Have the endorsement of a director and attach it to the application.

funding.value: The page says having a means of funding is essential for admission, which is a funding-before-admission rule, so no funding code is given.

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold a Spanish bachelor's and master's degree, or the equivalent.
entry_route.quote: As a rule, applicants seeking admission to an official doctoral programme must hold a Spanish bachelor’s degree or equivalent and a Spanish master’s degree or equivalent

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the programme page.

notes: The page says the academic committee prioritises students who already have a thesis supervisor appointed. Admission letters are issued by the UPC Manresa doctoral support unit. Marine Sciences (Civil and Environmental Engineering school) is a separate UPC doctorate and not included here.
